name: tanstack-db-notion-adapter
description: Offline-first, end-to-end typed TanStack DB collections backed by Notion data sources

scripts.build:example: npm run build:example:todos && npm run build:example:notes && npm run build:example:reliability
scripts.schema:generate: npm run build && cd examples/todos && node ../../dist/cli.js generate
scripts.schema:pull: npm run build && cd examples/todos && node ../../dist/cli.js pull
scripts.schema:push: npm run build && cd examples/todos && node ../../dist/cli.js push
scripts.schema:notes:generate: npm run build && cd examples/notes && node ../../dist/cli.js generate
scripts.schema:notes:pull: npm run build && cd examples/notes && node ../../dist/cli.js pull
scripts.schema:notes:push: npm run build && cd examples/notes && node ../../dist/cli.js push
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p examples/todos/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/notes/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/reliability/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:example && npm run test:package
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:notes: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:notes:api" "npm:dev:notes:web"
scripts.dev:reliability: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:reliability:api" "npm:dev:reliability:web"
